title: Experimenting
subtitle: 「試驗／嘗試／探索」，究竟是哪一種 experimenting？
description: 「試驗／嘗試／探索」，究竟是哪一種 experimenting？

words.note: 非常接近 experimenting 的日常說法，強調先實際試一個方法、產品或做法，看看效果如何。
words.example: We are trying out a new way of organising the meetings.
words.exampleZh: 我們正在試用一種新的會議安排方式。

exercises.original: We are experimenting with a new scheduling app for a week to see whether the team likes it.
exercises.zh: 我們正在試用一款新的排程應用程式一星期，看看團隊是否喜歡。

options.explanation: for a week + see whether the team likes it 表示實際先用看看，try out an app 是最自然的日常搭配。
語氣過度科學化；普通辦公軟件試用通常不叫 controlled experiment。
practise 是練習技能，不是試用產品。
researching 可以只閱讀評價或比較資料，原句已經在實際使用 app。
原句只是一個小團隊試用，而且沒有 national rollout。
是形容詞，不能作進行式謂語替代。

exercises.original: The chef is experimenting with a new oven before deciding whether to buy it.
exercises.zh: 廚師正在試用新焗爐，再決定是否購買。

options.explanation: 直接使用產品看看是否合適，正是 try out。

options.text: testing the waters with the market
options.explanation: 此慣用語是觀察市場／人群反應，不是試用一件設備。
廚師不是練習焗爐這項技能，而是在評估設備。
若只是看規格可說 exploring options；本句已實際使用。

exercises.original: Students are experimenting with a new note-taking method this week.
exercises.zh: 學生本星期正在試用一種新的筆記方法。

options.explanation: new method + this week 表示低風險的初步實際嘗試。
表示排除可能性，意思不同。
原句強調新方法，還在看看是否有效，並非單純熟練已確立技巧。

words.note: 強調檢查某方法、產品、系統或假設是否有效、可靠或符合要求。
words.example: The engineers are testing a new battery design.
words.exampleZh: 工程師正在測試一種新的電池設計。

exercises.original: Engineers are experimenting with the new battery to determine whether it meets the required safety standard.
exercises.zh: 工程師正在測試新電池，看它是否符合所需安全標準。

options.explanation: meets the required safety standard 提供明確判定標準，所以是 verification-focused testing。
太開放，不能突出 pass/fail 標準。
太隨意，不適合工程安全驗證。
同樣沒有正式測試標準。
是觀察反應／需求，不是產品安全測試。
形容詞，不能替代正在進行的動作。

exercises.original: The software team is experimenting with the system under heavy traffic to check whether it remains stable.
exercises.zh: 軟件團隊正在高流量下測試系統，以檢查它是否保持穩定。

options.explanation: heavy traffic + stability criterion 是標準性能測試。
若只研究不同架構才合適；此處已有具體 system 和測試條件。
太非正式，也沒有性能驗證意味。
survey 通常收集意見／資料，不是壓力測試系統。

exercises.original: The laboratory is experimenting with each sample to see whether it contains the target substance.
exercises.zh: 實驗室正在檢測每個樣本，看是否含有目標物質。

options.explanation: sample + presence/absence question 是明確檢驗目的。
不適合實驗室正式檢驗。

words.note: 強調開放式了解可能性、方向或方法，不一定已有固定假設或明確成功標準。
words.example: The team is exploring different ways to reduce energy use.
words.exampleZh: 團隊正在探索不同方法以減少能源使用。

exercises.original: The team is experimenting with several possible ways to reduce energy use but has not chosen one to test yet.
exercises.zh: 團隊正在探索幾種降低能源使用的可能方法，但尚未選定其中一種進行測試。

options.explanation: has not chosen one to test yet 是關鍵；仍處於了解選項與可能性的階段。
testing 暗示已選定具體方案並檢查結果。
需要小規模實施具體方案。
更正式、實際操作程度更高。

exercises.original: Researchers are experimenting with possible explanations for the unexpected pattern before designing a study.
exercises.zh: 研究人員正在探索這個意外模式的可能解釋，之後才設計研究。

options.explanation: possible explanations + before designing study 表示還在 conceptual exploration。
尚未有研究設計，不能說已在驗證。
形容詞不能作進行式動作。

exercises.original: The company is experimenting with possible alternatives to its current packaging.
exercises.zh: 公司正在探索現有包裝的可能替代方案。

options.explanation: possible alternatives 是典型 options-discovery 語境。
原句尚未選定 final design。
沒有證據表示已進入 controlled experiment。
正式推出通常是探索之後。
名詞，句中需要 -ing 動詞。

words.note: 英式英語常見，表示在正式採用前先進行有限範圍試行。
words.example: The council is trialling a new bus route for six months.
words.exampleZh: 市議會正在試行一條新巴士路線六個月。

exercises.original: The council is experimenting with a new bus route for six months before deciding whether to make it permanent.
exercises.zh: 市議會正在試行一條新巴士路線六個月，再決定是否永久保留。

options.explanation: fixed six-month period + real-world service + decision on permanency 是正式試行的典型線索。British English 中 trialling 很自然。
巴士路線不是技能練習。
已經實際運行，不只是探索。
對公共交通政策太隨意。

exercises.original: The company is experimenting with a four-day working week for three months.
exercises.zh: 公司正在試行三個月的四天工作週。

options.explanation: limited duration + real workplace implementation = trial.
如果只討論政策選項才是 exploring；本句已實際執行三個月。
與 three months temporary period 矛盾。
美式拼法 trialing 可見，但本課採 British English，偏好 trialling。

exercises.original: The school is experimenting with a later start time for one term.
exercises.zh: 學校正在一個學期內試行較遲上課時間。

options.explanation: one term 是限定時期，之後通常會評估是否採用，因此是試行。
在 is 後需要 -ing 形式。

words.note: 表示先在小規模、限定地區或小組中實施，再決定是否全面推行。
words.example: The hospital is piloting the system in two wards.
words.exampleZh: 醫院正在兩個病房試點推行該系統。

exercises.original: The hospital is experimenting with the new electronic record system in two wards before introducing it everywhere.
exercises.zh: 醫院正在兩個病房試點推行新的電子病歷系統，之後才考慮全面引入。
exercises.upgrade: piloting · 試點推行；先導試行

options.explanation: in two wards + before introducing everywhere 明確是 small-scale pilot。
與兩個病房的限定範圍矛盾。

exercises.original: The government is experimenting with the benefit scheme in one region before a national rollout.
exercises.zh: 政府正在一個地區試點推行福利計劃，之後才全國推出。

options.explanation: one region + national rollout later 是典型政策試點結構。
語氣過於商業／非正式；政府 scheme 有明確 pilot design。

exercises.original: The university is experimenting with the programme among 100 students before offering it to the whole campus.
exercises.zh: 大學正先在 100 名學生中試行該計劃，再考慮向全校提供。

options.explanation: limited participant group + possible wider rollout 是 pilot 的定義性線索。

words.note: 最廣泛的日常說法，表示做某事看看能否成功；不一定像 experimenting 那樣強調變量、比較或反覆測試。
words.example: She is trying a different study routine this month.
words.exampleZh: 她這個月正在嘗試不同的學習安排。

exercises.original: She is experimenting with a different route to work this week to see if it is faster.
exercises.zh: 她本星期正在嘗試一條不同的上班路線，看是否較快。

options.explanation: 一般個人低風險行為只需 try，不需要 experiment 的正式或反覆測試意味。
此句需要進行式動詞 trying。

exercises.original: He is experimenting with a new café today because his usual one is closed.
exercises.zh: 因常去的咖啡店關門，他今天試試另一間新咖啡店。

options.explanation: one-off everyday choice 是 try 的自然語境，不必暗示反覆實驗。

exercises.original: We are experimenting with leaving ten minutes earlier tomorrow to avoid traffic.
exercises.zh: 我們打算明天嘗試早十分鐘出門，以避開交通。

options.explanation: 這只是日常嘗試一個做法，並非正式實驗。try doing 表示試某方法看看結果。

words.note: 表示非正式地對機器、設定、設計或方法作小改動，看能否改善。
words.example: He spent the afternoon tinkering with the camera settings.
words.exampleZh: 他整個下午都在反覆調整相機設定。

exercises.original: He spent the afternoon experimenting with the camera settings, making small adjustments one at a time.
exercises.zh: 他整個下午都在反覆調整相機設定，每次只作小改動。
exercises.upgrade: tinkering with · 小幅調整；反覆試改

options.explanation: small adjustments one at a time 是 tinkering 的典型語義，帶非正式試改感。
若是在練攝影技巧可用，但本句是改 settings。
語氣太正式，沒有 pass/fail 標準。
spent the afternoon 後需要 -ing 形式。

exercises.original: The developer is experimenting with the code to improve loading speed, changing small sections and checking the result.
exercises.zh: 開發者正在反覆試改程式碼以提高載入速度，每次改小部分再看效果。

options.explanation: small edits + check results 是典型 iterative tinkering。
是推出產品，不是改 code。
開發者不是練基本技能，而是在微調現有 code。

exercises.original: She is experimenting with the layout, moving buttons slightly and changing the spacing.
exercises.zh: 她正在反覆小幅調整版面，稍微移動按鈕並改變間距。

options.explanation: moving slightly + spacing changes are small iterative adjustments.
原句沒有正式實驗設計。
若沒有 with the layout 結構不完整；本題目標片語需保留 with。

words.note: 非常非正式，表示沒有太大壓力地嘗試不同設定、工具、想法或創意效果。
words.example: She was playing around with different colour combinations.
words.exampleZh: 她正在隨意試不同的顏色配搭。

exercises.original: She is experimenting with different colour combinations just for fun.
exercises.zh: 她只是為了好玩，隨意試不同顏色配搭。
exercises.upgrade: playing around with · 隨意試玩；玩弄看看

options.explanation: just for fun 是關鍵線索；沒有正式目標或標準，語氣非常 informal。
她是在探索配搭，不是重複練固定技巧。
與 just for fun 不符。
形容詞，不能代替進行式動作。

exercises.original: He spent an hour experimenting with the music software without trying to produce a finished track.
exercises.zh: 他花了一小時隨便試玩音樂軟件，並沒有打算完成一首作品。
exercises.upgrade: playing around with · 隨便試試

options.explanation: without trying to produce a finished track 表示低壓、無固定成果的探索。
沒有考試或固定技巧目標。

exercises.original: The children were experimenting with the drawing app, changing brushes and effects freely.
exercises.zh: 孩子們正在隨意試玩繪圖應用程式，自由更換畫筆和效果。
exercises.upgrade: playing around with · 玩弄看看

options.explanation: freely changing brushes/effects 是 informal exploratory play。
原句是在試多種工具，不是一個固定技巧。
若不接 app 作受詞，資訊不完整；目標片語是 playing around with。

words.note: 慣用語，表示先作有限嘗試，以了解市場、群體或情況的反應，再決定下一步。
words.example: The company is testing the waters before launching the service nationally.
words.exampleZh: 公司在全國推出服務前先試水溫。

exercises.original: The company is experimenting with a limited release in one city to see whether customers are interested.
exercises.zh: 公司先在一個城市有限推出，看看顧客是否有興趣，藉此試水溫。
exercises.upgrade: testing the waters · 試水溫；先看看反應

options.explanation: limited release + see whether customers are interested 是典型市場反應試探。
目標是 demand/interest，不是安全標準。
這裡是慣用語，不是測水質。

exercises.original: Before opening a full shop, the designer is experimenting by selling a small range online.
exercises.zh: 設計師在開完整店舖前，先在網上賣少量產品試水溫。
exercises.upgrade: testing the waters · 先試水溫

options.explanation: small range + before full shop 表示先觀察 demand，再決定是否擴大。
可抽象描述，但不如 idiom 自然。

exercises.original: The publisher is experimenting with a short digital edition before committing to a full series.
exercises.zh: 出版社先推出短篇數碼版本試探反應，再決定是否製作完整系列。
exercises.upgrade: testing the waters · 試探反應

options.explanation: small initial release + before committing 是此 idiom 的核心。

words.note: 非常自然的口語表達，表示願意先試某個方法或活動。
words.example: We decided to give the new software a try.
words.exampleZh: 我們決定試用這套新軟件。

exercises.original: We decided to experiment with the new software for a few days before buying a licence.
exercises.zh: 我們決定先試用幾天新軟件，再決定是否購買授權。
exercises.upgrade: give the new software a try · 試用一下新軟件
exercises.answer: give the new software a try

options.text: give the new software a try
options.explanation: short initial use + low commitment 是這個口語表達最自然的情境。
過度正式，像研究軟件而非試用。

exercises.original: She is experimenting with yoga because a friend recommended it.
exercises.zh: 朋友推薦瑜伽，所以她打算試試看。
exercises.upgrade: giving yoga a try · 試試瑜伽

options.explanation: 初次嘗試活動、沒有長期承諾，是 give it a try 的典型語境。
原句沒有比賽或持續練習。

exercises.original: He is experimenting with cycling to work once this week.
exercises.zh: 他本星期打算試一次踩單車上班。
exercises.upgrade: giving cycling to work a try · 試試踩單車上班
exercises.answer: giving cycling to work a try

options.text: giving cycling to work a try
options.explanation: one initial attempt 是 low-commitment trial。
個人行為不是制度 pilot。
重點是 commuting method，不是自行車技能。
標準結構是 give X a try。

words.note: 正式、科學化，表示有控制條件、程序或研究問題的實驗活動。
words.example: The researchers are conducting experiments on plant growth.
words.exampleZh: 研究人員正在進行植物生長實驗。

exercises.original: The researchers are experimenting with plant growth under controlled light conditions.
exercises.zh: 研究人員正在受控制光照條件下進行植物生長實驗。

options.explanation: researchers + controlled conditions 是正式實驗設計的明確線索。
語氣太隨意，不能表達 controlled methodology。

exercises.original: The laboratory team is experimenting to determine how temperature affects the reaction rate.
exercises.zh: 實驗室團隊正在進行實驗，以確定溫度如何影響反應速度。

options.explanation: laboratory + causal variable temperature + reaction rate = formal experiment.
沒有反映受控變量測試。
experimentation 是名詞，並非形容詞；此處需動詞片語。

exercises.original: Scientists are experimenting with different concentrations while keeping all other conditions constant.
exercises.zh: 科學家正在測試不同濃度，同時保持所有其他條件不變。

options.explanation: one variable changes while others stay constant，這正是 controlled experimental logic。
不是此處標準動作表達。

words.note: 表示正式或半正式地進行一系列試驗，常見於產品、系統、臨床、工程或流程測試。
words.example: The laboratory is running trials on the new material.
words.exampleZh: 實驗室正在對新材料進行試驗。

exercises.original: The laboratory is experimenting with the new material in repeated durability tests.
exercises.zh: 實驗室正在對新材料進行一連串耐用性試驗。
exercises.upgrade: running trials · 進行試驗；做試驗

options.explanation: repeated durability tests 表示一系列正式試驗，run trials 很自然。
trial run 是名詞，不能替代正在進行的動作。

exercises.original: The engineers are experimenting with several prototypes under identical conditions.
exercises.zh: 工程師正在相同條件下對數個原型進行試驗。

options.explanation: prototypes + identical conditions = formal comparative trials。

exercises.original: The company is experimenting with the new packaging machine over fifty production cycles.
exercises.zh: 公司正在五十個生產循環中對新包裝機進行試驗。

options.explanation: fifty production cycles 表示重複、有結構的正式試驗。

words.note: 表示在多個可能選項中試探、比較或尋找更好方案。
words.example: The company is exploring alternatives to plastic packaging.
words.exampleZh: 公司正在探索塑膠包裝的替代方案。

exercises.original: The manufacturer is experimenting with alternatives to plastic packaging but has not selected a replacement yet.
exercises.zh: 製造商正在探索塑膠包裝的替代方案，但尚未選定替代品。
exercises.upgrade: exploring alternatives · 探索替代方案

options.explanation: has not selected a replacement yet 表示仍在 option-search stage。

exercises.original: The school is experimenting with alternatives to traditional homework.
exercises.zh: 學校正在探索傳統家課以外的替代方案。
exercises.upgrade: exploring alternatives · 探索其他方案

options.explanation: alternative to existing practice 是這個片語的典型策略語境。
沒有實際大規模試點線索。

options.text: testing a single final option only

exercises.original: The team is experimenting with other ways of storing the data because the current system is expensive.
exercises.zh: 由於現有系統昂貴，團隊正探索其他資料儲存方法。
exercises.upgrade: exploring alternatives · 尋找替代方法

options.explanation: current system problem + other ways 表示 strategy search。

words.note: 解釋性很強的自然表達，特別適合反覆調整方法、看看哪一種最有效。
words.example: The teacher is trying different approaches to improve participation.
words.exampleZh: 老師正在嘗試不同方法以提高參與度。

exercises.original: The teacher is experimenting with several ways of encouraging quieter students to speak.
exercises.zh: 老師正在嘗試不同方法，鼓勵較安靜的學生發言。
exercises.upgrade: trying different approaches · 嘗試不同方法

options.explanation: several ways + practical classroom problem 是自然的 method-comparison paraphrase。

exercises.original: The team is experimenting with different ways to shorten the approval process.
exercises.zh: 團隊正在嘗試不同做法，以縮短審批流程。
exercises.upgrade: trying different approaches · 嘗試不同做法

options.explanation: different ways + practical improvement task，這個表達清楚自然。
與 different approaches 的比較探索不符。
experimenting 暗示已有實際嘗試。

exercises.original: The therapist is experimenting with several techniques to help the patient sleep better.
exercises.zh: 治療師正在嘗試不同技巧，幫助病人睡得更好。
exercises.upgrade: trying different approaches · 嘗試不同方法

options.explanation: several techniques + practical outcome = repeated method comparison in a professional setting.
太隨意，也與 professional therapeutic purpose 不符。

falseSynonyms.zh: trying 可以只做一次；experimenting 更容易暗示比較不同做法、觀察結果或反覆調整。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is trying a new recipe tonight. She is experimenting with different cooking temperatures to see which works best.

falseSynonyms.zh: testing 通常有明確標準或問題；experimenting 可以更開放、更探索性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Engineers are testing whether the battery meets safety standards. Designers are experimenting with several battery shapes.

falseSynonyms.zh: exploring 可只是在研究選項；experimenting 通常已有實際嘗試。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The team is exploring possible locations. The team is experimenting with a new layout in one office.

falseSynonyms.zh: pilot 通常代表一個有範圍、有期限的先導計劃，而一般 experimenting 不一定如此正式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The school is experimenting with different classroom activities. The district is piloting the new curriculum in five schools.

falseSynonyms.zh: practising 的目的通常是提高已有技能；experimenting 的目的通常是看看不同方法會有甚麼效果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is practising the piano piece every day. She is experimenting with different ways of phrasing the melody.

falseSynonyms.zh: 研究可以包括閱讀、收集資料；experimenting 通常需要實際操作或測試。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is researching different insulation materials. He is experimenting with three materials in a test wall.

falseSynonyms.zh: experimenting 來自 experiment；experience 表示經驗／經歷，意思不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They are experimenting with a new method. She has extensive experience with the method.

falseSynonyms.zh: experimenting 是進行嘗試的動作；experimental 是形容詞「實驗性的」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The team is experimenting with a new process. The team is using an experimental process.
